svg.title: When a check fails: Cost and time
svg.desc: When a check fails. Cost and recorded time, with the highest total in each matched comparison set to 100%. 11 matched tasks. Cost: Fresh 54.0%, Compact 91.2%, Continue 100.0%. Time: Fresh 57.2%, Compact 91.4%, Continue 100.0%. Each comparison sorts ascending.
